page_title: PAU 2-1 HEI | St. Pauli v Heidenheim 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' Ricky-Jade Jones is being substituted because of an injury. Alexander Blessin sends Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) on the pitch.
90+5' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Heidenheim are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' A pass lands at the feet of Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Heidenheim move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
87' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
85' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
84' An attempted cross from Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
84' Heidenheim are ruled offside.
83' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
82' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) will deliver the corner kick.
82' The Heidenheim players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. The referee signals a corner kick to Heidenheim.
81' The foul by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) was seen by Soren Storks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
81' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
80' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.

79' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. St. Pauli can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Julian Niehues is replaced by Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim).
78' Heidenheim are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
76' Substitution. Martijn Kaars did his best and is replaced by Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli).
75' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
73' The attendance for today's match is 29546.
71' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) sends the corner into the box, but Diant Ramaj intercepts it and averts the threat.
71' A pass into the penalty area from Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to St. Pauli.

70' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
69' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Soren Storks had an easy-decision to make.

67' Jonas Fohrenbach plays a short pass through to Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) coming on for Adrian Beck.
64' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Tim Siersleben will be replaced by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim).
64' 2 - 1 Goal! Stefan Schimmer plays a simple square pass into the feet of Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.

63' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
63' The ball goes behind for a corner. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
60' A crossfield pass from Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) fails to find any of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Heidenheim.
57' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
55' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
53' 2 - 0 Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Diant Ramaj with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
51' A player from Heidenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
51' The Heidenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Heidenheim are taking a throw-in.
47' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

47' What a sweet touch by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Nikola Vasilj to hold. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Omar Haktab Traore comes on in place of Thomas Keller (Heidenheim).
46' Frank Schmidt has made a change at the break. Stefan Schimmer has come on in place of Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim).
46' Half-time substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) will not participate anymore and Adam Dzwigala is coming on.
46' The whistle blows and Soren Storks starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Heidenheim.
45+3' Alexander Blessin appears to have said too much and referee Soren Storks comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
45' The game is pretty dull as Heidenheim are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
42' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
41' St. Pauli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
40' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Flag up against Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
37' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will take a throw-in.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Joel Fujita, then sends the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
33' St. Pauli are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.

31' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
29' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
28' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge.
27' Heidenheim play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Sands (St. Pauli) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
22' That's a well-taken pass by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
21' Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) is able to continue to play.
20' Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

19' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
18' James Sands (St. Pauli) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Diant Ramaj is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
16' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Soren Storks who sees an offensive foul.
14' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
13' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post.
12' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) touches the ball with his hand.
11' The Heidenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
9' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
8' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
7' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diant Ramaj, who smothers the ball.

6' The cross into the penalty area from Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
6' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. It's a free kick to Heidenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli), but the defence gets it clear.
2' Heidenheim keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for St. Pauli.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Soren Storks.
